description: The app's windows (main, and window-<n> it opens, T-511): the app's own commands, the reads (and their subscriptions), connecting agents, installing an update and writing to a project's reviews (as the user, ATM-572) on the user's action, the window's own shell, title and a new window at one of the dashboard's pages, its tabs kept for the next start (and a Reload of its page) and what needs the user (the app's badge and notifications, which the app sends itself) and an external link in the user's browser (open-url, which checks it), nothing else (no core or plugin APIs: the updater only through the app's two commands, the opener only through open-url)
